body.statement: For every declared score dimension \(q\in\mathbb N\), when \(J=1\), \(C_n^{\mathrm{proj}}(\alpha)\) equals the profile of the ordinary \(q+1\)-dimensional Gaussian Wald ellipsoid under the restriction \(s_{1,n}=0\).
body.justification: This reduction verifies that the construction nests standard inference when label ambiguity disappears.
body.gap: The reduction is a required coherence check rather than a claimed departure from standard Wald theory.
body.consumer: Software can test the implementation against ordinary one-label regression output.
